question: In 2016, Pandit Birju Maharaj won the Filmfare Award for Best Choreography for which film?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bajirao Mastani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj won the Filmfare Award for Best Choreography in 2016 for the song "**Mohe Rang Do Laal**" from the film **Bajirao Mastani**.
 
• The song features **Deepika Padukone** portraying Mastani, performing intricate Kathak moves under Pandit Birju Maharaj's choreography.
 
• This win marked a significant moment as it showcased the integration of classical Indian dance forms in mainstream Bollywood cinema.
 
• **Bajirao Mastani**, directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali, is a period drama based on the life of Peshwa Bajirao I and his love story with Mastani.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj is a legendary Kathak dancer and choreographer, known for his contribution to preserving and modernizing the dance form globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak**

 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major classical dance forms of India, originating from Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The word "Kathak" is derived from the Sanskrit word "Katha," meaning story, and "Kathakar," meaning storyteller.
 
• It is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures (mudras) and facial expressions.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj is considered a doyen of the Lucknow gharana of Kathak.
 
 
 
• **Bajirao Mastani**
 
 
• Released in 2015, the film starred Ranveer Singh, Deepika Padukone, and Priyanka Chopra in lead roles.
 
• The movie is based on the historical romance of Maratha warrior Bajirao and his second wife Mastani.
 
• It received numerous accolades for its direction, performances, music, and choreography.
 
 
 
• **Filmfare Award for Best Choreography**
 
 
• It is an annual award presented by Filmfare as part of its Filmfare Awards for Hindi films.
 
• The award recognizes excellence in dance choreography in Bollywood films.
 
• Choreographers like Saroj Khan, Vaibhavi Merchant, and Farah Khan have won this award multiple times.
 
 
 
• **Pandit Birju Maharaj's Contributions**
 
 
• He was born on February 4, 1938, and hailed from a family of Kathak dancers.
 
• He modernized Kathak while retaining its traditional essence, making it more accessible to global audiences.
 
• He has been honored with numerous awards, including the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian award.
 
• In addition to dance, he was also a gifted classical singer and percussionist.
